set-var "lrn-id" get-val-public "itemId"
learnosity items [
  item questions [
    bowtie stimulus "A 68-year-old post-operative patient presents with a temperature of 38.9°C, heart rate 118, blood pressure 88/52, and rising lactate. What are the priority interventions and monitoring parameters?"
      column-titles [
        "Actions to Take"
        "Condition Most Likely"
        "Parameters to Monitor"
      ] possible-responses [
      [
        "Obtain blood cultures"
        "Administer prescribed fluid bolus"
        "Initiate broad-spectrum antibiotics"
        "Apply warming blanket"
        "Insert central venous catheter"
      ]
      [
        "Sepsis"
        "Hypovolemic shock"
        "Anaphylaxis"
        "Acute coronary syndrome"
      ]
      [
        "Serum lactate"
        "Mean arterial pressure"
        "Urine output"
        "Core body temperature"
        "Hemoglobin level"
      ]
    ] valid-response [
      [
        "Obtain blood cultures"
        "Administer prescribed fluid bolus"
      ]
      [
        "Sepsis"
      ]
      [
        "Serum lactate"
        "Mean arterial pressure"
      ]
    ] {}
  ] {}
] {}..
